svg.title: Flower Anatomy Drag and Drop
svg.desc: A static interactive SVG learning tool for flower anatomy without JavaScript.

g.text: Hint: The base holds the flower.

text.tspan: 1. Look at the flower diagram on the left.
2. Click words in the Word Bank to reveal
3. Use Hint to see a clue.
4. Use Check Answer to see all parts.
5. Use Reset to clear the diagram.

g.text: The pistil is the female part, located in the center.
You have identified all the parts correctly.
Look at the diagram to see the connections.
This will clear all your labels.

svg.script: /* No JS allowed, handled via anchors above */
